component.name: PyCUPS
component.summary: CUPS Archive for retained print jobs
CUPS Archive para trabalhos de impressão retidos

description.p: PyCUPS is a GNOME desktop application for viewing the local CUPS job history, previewing retained documents, exporting originals, and reprinting complete jobs or selected PDF pages.
PyCUPS é um aplicativo GNOME para visualizar o histórico local do CUPS, pré-visualizar documentos retidos, exportar originais e reimprimir trabalhos completos ou páginas selecionadas de um PDF.

Flexible PDF reprints include a destination-paper preview based on IPP dimensions, printable margins, and scaling. Settings cover only global CUPS values after an explicit Apply action and administrator authorization. Installation and startup never change them. A privacy-focused first-run flow can compare live values with an editable retention suggestion. A blocking readiness dialog verifies CUPS after global changes before the interface resumes.

A reimpressão flexível de PDF inclui preview do papel de destino com dimensões, margens e escala informadas via IPP. As configurações tratam somente de valores globais do CUPS e exigem Aplicar e autorização. A instalação e a inicialização nunca alteram esses valores. Um assistente inicial sobre privacidade compara os valores atuais com uma sugestão de retenção editável. Um diálogo bloqueante confirma o retorno do CUPS após mudanças globais antes de liberar novamente a interface.

description.p: Keep zoomed-document panning stable by anchoring drag coordinates to the fixed preview viewport and canceling queued recentering when a drag begins.
Load the required PyGObject Cairo bridge, render external CUPS text literally, and combine document controls into one compact line.
Center automatic startup update notices by waiting until the main window is mapped and active before presenting its transient child.
Add zoom, rotation, wheel control, and panning to the main preview; stabilize action labels; and publish complete bilingual GitHub documentation with screenshots.
Block the interface after global CUPS changes until fresh, stable IPP connections confirm the restarted scheduler is ready.
Make the onboarding welcome and completion pages responsive by removing isolated internal scrollbars and retaining only a page-level fallback for short windows.
Add a three-step privacy-focused welcome flow with live CUPS values, editable 30/90-day retention suggestions, explicit apply or skip, and a reusable menu entry.
Standardize the user-facing product name as PyCUPS while retaining CUPS Archive as its description and preserving technical compatibility.
Add fixed settings actions, left-side reprint preview, unlimited spool-file retention, and isolated per-job cached files.
Keep long destination-paper names inside a stable, ellipsized selector without compressing the row label.
Fix the blank startup history pane by synchronizing printer-filter initialization with job-row visibility.
Add multi-printer checkbox filtering, target-paper PDF reprint previews, GitHub update checks, and tabbed global CUPS settings.
Add on-demand CUPS authentication, printer filtering, and direct retained-file checks for every eligible job.
Load retention controls from live CUPS values and never change them during installation or startup.
Initial release with selected-page PDF reprinting and CUPS retention administration.
